case: UUID array file writers preserve values through JSON, CSV, XLSX and SQL replay
contract: The UUID[] result retains its native type, array text, JSON values and array_send bytes after typed rebinding.
JSON and CSV exports preserve the exact array text; XLSX stores it as a string cell without formulas.
SQL-file replay restores the native UUID[] type, array text, JSON value and wire bytes in PostgreSQL.
The SQL replay leaves a pre-existing sibling UUID array row unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<absolute-evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_uuid_array_file_exports_preserve_values_for_calc_reimport -- --ignored --exact --test-threads=1

remaining: Other array types, file-writer configurations, session combinations and the wider B3 matrix remain open.
